text:
jo: Pinging the docs team — I opened a PR to add a short 'tenant affinity + autoscale' example for Dedicated. Includes YAML, terraform, and a tiny python SDK snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4281

anika: Nice. Can you call out explicitly how affinity affects autoscale cooldown and burst behavior? A short sentence is enough.

jo: Added: 'Affinity narrows placement candidates; autoscale may trigger burst or queueing when preferred pools lack capacity.'

rahul: Please use tenant_selector everywhere (we've standardized on that). Also add a tiny migration note for reserved_pool -> dedicated_pool mapping.

jo: Switched labels and added a migration paragraph mapping reserved_pool to dedicated_pool and noting the preemptible flag is deprecated.

anika: Could we include a one-line curl that shows placement=dedicated vs placement=shared? Helps operators.

jo: Added curl + sample jq outputs.

legal: Quick review on SLA wording: replace 'SLA may break' with 'soft affinity may increase latency during placement or preemption events; hard isolation preserves SLA.'

jo: Updated SLA phrasing per legal.

docs-bot: PR #4281 opened by jo — review requested @anika @rahul

anika: Added a PromQL alert example for dedicated.pool.utilization and fixed a broken anchor link.

ci-bot: docs CI: all checks passed for PR #4281 — staging build: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/tenant-affinity-autoscale

rahul: LGTM. I'll follow up with a separate PR for auth examples in SDK snippets.

jo: Merged after CI. Thanks all :tada:

anika: Filed ticket DOC-812 to collect tenancy examples into examples/tenancy/README.md

jo: Closing thread.
